name: Custom Reido
source:
Arisugawa high school is a prestigious girls' school well known around the world. Hero inherits from his uncle as the director of this school. The school turns out to be a slave training organization on a nationwide scale with a deep connections to the political and financial world. And it's main character's job to fulfill all kind of custom slave requests.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有栖川高中是一所享誉世界的著名女子学校。英雄从他叔叔那里继承了这所学校的校长。这所学校原来是一个全国性的奴隶训练组织，与政界和金融界有着深厚的联系。主角的工作就是满足各种定制奴隶的要求。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
